US Open Tennis: Gauff and Zheng Advance in Women's Singles

In the US Open 2026 tennis tournament, American player Coco Gauff advanced to the next round by defeating Spain's Cristina Bucsa in straight sets. Meanwhile, Chinese qualifier Zheng Qinwen achieved a comeback victory against American Madison Keys. The tournament is ongoing, with players competing in the women's singles matches.
